## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Related issue

Link the issue, if there is one.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks you ran and their results. Explain any checks you could not run.

## UI evidence

For visible changes, add screenshots or a short recording. Otherwise, write "Not applicable."

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where behavior changed.
- [ ] I removed secrets, private data, and generated local artifacts from the diff.
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`.
